subject: Post-call: NovaGrid discovery + proposed mutual action plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@novagrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: NovaGrid discovery + proposed mutual action plan

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap and the MAP I promised to sketch out so we stay aligned. I listed the core goals, the key pain we heard, and proposed milestones + owners. See inline and attached PDF (NovaGrid_MAP_v1.pdf).

Top pain points we noted
- High per-call inference cost and inconsistent tail latency on peak billing cycles (especially during billing reconciliation windows)
- Risk profile for customer PII in analytics pipelines; need stronger audit trails and KMS integration for keys
- Current vendor lock-in makes model upgrades and A/B rollouts slow and risky for Ops

Stated goals
1) Reduce per-token inference cost by 40–50% on weekday peak load without degrading 95th percentile latency beyond 200ms for short-form prompts (<=512 tokens).
2) Establish an approved private deployment option with VPC + KMS for PII-handling workloads by end of Q4.
3) Shorten model rollout time from weeks to days with canary/A-B and automated fallbacks.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level) — target dates are draft
- Week 1 (Aug 3–7): Technical deep-dive (security & infra) — owners: Jordan (Redwood), Olivia (NovaGrid infra) — deliverable: infra questionnaires + baseline perf logs
- Week 2 (Aug 10–14): Proof-of-concept (3-day performance run) — owners: Redwood eng (Marissa) + NovaGrid eng (you) — deliverable: perf report, cost delta
- Week 4 (Aug 24–28): Procurement & contract review — owners: NovaGrid procurement (cc procurement@novagrid.com) + Jordan/Legal — deliverable: draft SOW and pricing sheet
- Week 6 (Sep 7–11): Pilot kickoff (sandbox traffic) — owners: NovaGrid product + Redwood CS — deliverable: pilot acceptance criteria met

Decision process / stakeholders
- Olivia Park — Technical champion (evaluation lead)
- Mark Torres, VP Finance — Budget approver (procurement + final sign-off)
- Procurement team (procurement@novagrid.com) — Contract negotiation
- Jordan Blake (Redwood) — Commercial lead and SLA negotiator
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — Engineering lead for the POC

Immediate asks for this week
1) Olivia — can you confirm the two sample datasets you want in the POC and the contact for Mark/Torres so I can include finance-level numbers?
2) Procurement — please confirm who owns contract redlines on your side and whether you prefer a single SOW or Master Services Agreement + Statement of Work.
3) Marissa & Rachel — I'll kick off a short list of needed perf metrics and an access plan; tagging you to coordinate logistics.

Attachment: NovaGrid_MAP_v1.pdf (one-page milestone & owner map), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (SLA bullets)

If that looks good I’ll send a one-page MAP as a shareable Drive link and propose an Aug 5 technical deep-dive slot (11am PT) — does that time work for you?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
